narrative.overview: Butter navigation sits beside a neutral bright canvas, white work surfaces, stronger ink and olive actions. On 24/10/2026 the user chose moderately airy reading density and selected the Liền mạch S mark from three logo directions. Be Vietnam Pro carries identity and interface. This refines Butter; it does not imply final screen acceptance.
keyCharacteristics: Butter navigation, neutral bright canvas and olive actions.
Liền mạch S mark and Be Vietnam Pro throughout identity and document work.
Readable titles, labelled deadlines and real business state.
Flat surfaces distinguished by tone, thin boundaries and space.
Collapsible navigation with deliberate, reducible motion.
dos: Do preserve butter navigation, warm white surroundings and olive actions.
Do use Be Vietnam Pro throughout identity and work and preserve the chosen Liền mạch mark.
Do preserve real state labels, readable titles and explicit deadlines.
Do preserve accessible collapsed names, drawer focus behavior and reduced motion.
Do adapt forms and tables consistently without changing business rules.
donts: Don't restore the superseded wine masthead or the rejected small-type three-pane inbox.
Don't add invented records, counts, AI capabilities or document previews.
Don't use large serif office headings.
Don't impose the inbox's attention composition on every business screen.
